lines.t: VERSE 1
When I was weak, You carried me
When I was lost, You made me see
Your mercy found me where I stood
Your grace has always been so good
PRE-CHORUS
And through the years, through every storm
Your faithful love has kept me warm
You never left, You never changed
Forever, Lord, You are the same
CHORUS
So I will wait, I will believe
Your promise is enough for me
Though I can't see You, still I know
You said You'd come, and You will come
YAHUSHUA, MY BLESSED HOPE
My heart is waiting for You
YAHUSHUA, MY BLESSED HOPE
Your word is faithful and true
And when my Savior calls my name
I'll run to You, I'll run to You
My Blessed Hope, my Blessed Hope
I'm waiting for You
VERSE 2
Your grace has held me every day
When I had nothing left to say
You gave me strength to carry on
And taught my heart to wait for dawn

YAHUSHUA, MY BLESSED HOPE

YAHUSHUA, MY BLESSED HOPE

You will fulfill

The One who promised
Will surely come
